notes.title: Version 0.11.0 released!
notes.notes:
Version 0.11.0 has been released!

This update has a few big updates. A few of these updates were raised in this post.

Features

Versus game mode
A new split screen versus mode has been added for local multiplayer or via Steam's remote play together. In this game mode you compete against each other to collect as many chickens as possible within a defined time limit. You can adjust how long you wish to play and how many power ups you wish to start out with.

https://i.imgur.com/fFccgis.gif

Player upgrades
The level up stats boost has been replaced with an option to select an upgrade. This upgrade allows you to choose a perk that will help you. It maxes out at level 5 and you can hold up to a max of 3 upgrades. Play around with different upgrade combinations to find one that suits your style of play best.

https://i.imgur.com/QREHtTO.gif

New map
A new map has been added. The city themed map adds a lot of obstacles to avoid and causes some chaos when you're pinched by so many zombies.

https://i.imgur.com/St6aFET.gif

New enemy
New enemy added! T-Rex. Watch out for the zombie T-Rex stomping you and your chickens.

https://i.imgur.com/457AsWD.gif

Change log

Here is a list of all other changes:

- Increased car and truck sizes
- Fix actor movement on different surfaces
- Remove unused grass settings
- Fixed bug unable to go to next level even though it's previously been completed
- added delay when killed to display end screen
- remove gun chicken spawning
- fix hidden mouse cursor
- added tween between looking at targets
- increased latency between same sound fx to prevent overlapping
- fix chickens pooping at same time
- fix many orphan nodes occurring
- fix newly created tweens causing lag
- fix vibrating of second controller when not used
- reduced frequency of chickens pooping
- fix gun audio sound levels
- fix chickens not spawning in zombie maps after some time
- reduced delay of shotguns fire rate. Now shoots faster.
- Increase enemies in Wildlands
- fix actors easily losing sight of opponents

notes.title: Hotfix 0.10.1
notes.notes: A bug was reported when playing a map for longer than 1 hour. The counter will reset as well as the score. This bug is now fixed! New times surviving for longer than 1 hour will now show up in the leaderboard as well as in your 'Best time'. Unfortunately previous times recorded (prior to this update) exceeding 1 hour will not appear.

notes.title: Lots of new environment assets in Version 0.10.0!
notes.notes:
This is the first major update since the game's Early Access release. I'm excited to share this update which visually updates all the maps in the game. Including some local co-op fixes.

https://i.imgur.com/fHlPNQm.png

UPDATES:
- Updated all maps with new assets for an improved visual experience.
- Reduced game file size.
- Reduced VRAM usage.
- Removed 'Max chickens', now there is no limit to the number of chickens to follow.

FIXES:
- Reduced laser damage (balance).
- Fixed co-op distance preventing players going off screen.
- Fixed incorrect raycasts on some actors.
- Fixed zombie chickens spawning off map.
- Removed 'Previous' and 'Next' buttons on character select screen when there are none.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.3 - New powerup added!!
notes.notes:
This patch is a little large as I've made a number of changes to reduce the game's disk size by 40%. So now you have extra hard drive space!

The exciting addition I've added into this patch is a new powerup. My plans for patches are mostly to fix bugs and improve performance. Updates would normally include new features, but I felt like I wanted to add content and didn't want to wait till I create a new update.

Helicopter chicken to the rescue! It's quite over powered but that's the joke and part of the fun. It will cost quite a hefty amount of chickens to buy this one though.

https://i.imgur.com/bxqr5JO.gif

I've noticed the game really drops in performance when there's lots of explosions. So I've been working hard to find clever ways to squeeze any optimizations I can. I hope it's better...not worse.

Man, chickens sometimes just don't want to follow you, especially in the map "Caged". Well...it's now fixed. No more running around hoping to wake up the chickens to follow you, they should now have your full attention.

I hope you have a great day, and as usual, below has the list of changes.

FEATURES:
- Added new powerup "Helicopter Chicken".

UPDATES:
- Reduced lightmap size.
- Faster rendering of shadows.
- Improved performance on explosions.
- Updated highlight color for Booster cards button.
- Improved performance of actor movement.
- Weapon projectiles will now shoot without confirming actor can see enemy.
- Reduced VRAM usage.

FIXES:
- Fixed Chicken Balls not colliding with other Chicken Balls.
- Fixed Buy Menu not showing correct number of chickens in wallet.
- Fixed Co-op time not showing for selected player.
- Fixed chickens not wanting to follow even though you're nearby.

notes.title: Version 0.8.0 released!
notes.notes:
Earlier this week the game was released and now I'm closing the week with an update!

There has been some reported cases of a breaking bug that will cause the game to crash. This happens when a player collects a second egg (which should display a set of booster cards) and the game will crash. I have made some changes to hopefully have fixed the issue in this update. EDIT: this issue still exists for some players. Will continue to investigate the issue to resolve ASAP. FIXED in 0.8.1

The main feature in this update is 2 new power ups. The baby chicks can now become chickens with the use of the 'Grow up' power up OR into fat chickens with the use of 'Hormones added'.

Chicks with 'Grow up' can be combined with 'Gimmie guns' to equip them with weapons.
https://i.imgur.com/m3En1Mx.gif

Chicks with 'Hormones added' can be combined with 'Gimmie guns' to equip them with bazookas and things will be eggs-plosive!
https://i.imgur.com/jOZlgj1.gif

Here is the full list of changes in v0.8.0:

FEATURES:
- Added new power up, "Grow up".
- Added new power up, "Hormones added".
- Added bind for 'B' key and 'Back' button to show buy menu in-game.
- Added left and right arrow keys to toggle through power ups.
- Added feedback button which links to a Google form.
- Added 5 Steam achievements to unlock.

IMPROVEMENTS:
- Improved Random Number Generator.
- Doubled the health of large gunner coyote for balance due to new power ups.
- Hunter's health has increased.
- Eggs have decreased in size.
- Eggs will float to player when nearby.
- Fix typo "equipt" to "equipped".
- Updated power up item descriptions.
- Reduced enemies in 'Toxic' map and have increased chickens.
- Adjusted exploding chicken to be spawned closer to player.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.7.1 added
notes.notes:
Thank you to those who have been playing the pre-released version!

I've noticed an issue with the following chickens losing sight of you when they immediately fall behind a tree/rock/building. This can be a pretty frustrating when your chicken army looses sight and you're under the time pressure. This is now fixed!

Chickens will now continue to follow you unless you've surpassed a distance away from them.
